Comments.UseMockServices: Set to true for GitHub Pages/static deployment because the site cannot rely on Aspire-hosted backend services.
Comments.UseApiGateway: Set to false for GitHub/static deployment because no runtime API Gateway is available in the browser-hosted site.
Comments.BaseUrl: Retained for parity with other environments but not used while mock services are enabled.
Comments.ApiGatewayUrl: Retained for parity with other environments but not used while mock services are enabled.
